coordinateSystem.note: No millimeter dimensions are canon at this stage. FX beyond physical silhouette are excluded from dimensional authority.

symmetry.rule: Asymmetry must be intentional and documented; AI view-to-view drift is not design asymmetry.

geometryVsFx.ears: Physical ear/fur geometry carries the flame-like silhouette; glow is optional FX.
geometryVsFx.tail: Physical split-tail/fur geometry must remain recognizable with all emissive/fire FX disabled.
geometryVsFx.foreheadMark: Surface marking/inlay identity; not dependent on glow.
geometryVsFx.rule: NT-001 must remain recognizable in unlit/clay render and physical print.

crossViewConstraints: left and right body lengths reconcile
tail root location reconciles in side/back/top
ear base and tip landmarks reconcile in front/side/back
marking placement is identical rather than reinterpreted
no environmental lighting used to define geometry

openGeometryDecisions.question: Is the signature tail one root splitting into two persistent physical lobes/branches, or one tail mass with an internal flame-shaped notch?
Exact physical boundary between white outer ear fur, orange inner flame-like fur, and optional elemental FX.
Whether the current back marking is retained as an optional marking or removed from the master design.
Final physical prototype scale in millimeters.

promotionRule: Do not mark any orthographic view APPROVED until the six-view pack passes cross-view reconciliation and the blocking geometry decisions are resolved.
